title: Best Gym Foods at Woolworths & Pak'nSave – NZ Guide
meta_desc: Practical NZ supermarket guide for gym‑goers: high‑protein staples, price checks at Woolworths & Pak'nSave, and smart shopping tips. Get your weekly list now.
intro: Whether you’re bulking, cutting or just staying fit, the right food buys can make a big difference to your results and your wallet. This guide breaks down the best high‑protein options you’ll find at Woolworths and Pak'nSave, highlights where you’re paying for branding, and gives you a ready‑to‑shop list for the week.

sections.heading: 1. Core Protein Staples – What to Fill Your Cart With
sections.body: Protein is the building block of muscle, and New Zealanders can meet most of their needs with whole‑food sources that are both affordable and nutrient‑dense. The 2024 NZ Nutrition Survey shows the average adult consumes about 75 g of protein per day – roughly 1.0 g/kg for a 75 kg person – leaving room for most gym‑goers to aim for 1.6–2.2 g/kg without supplements.
list: Chicken breast (skinless) – Woolworths NZ$12.90/kg, Pak'nSave NZ$9.90/kg
Lean beef mince (5% fat) – Woolworths NZ$13.50/kg, Pak'nSave NZ$10.50/kg
Eggs (large, free‑range) – Woolworths NZ$5.20/dozen, Pak'nSave NZ$4.30/dozen
Cottage cheese (low‑fat) – Woolworths NZ$4.80/500 g, Pak'nSave NZ$3.90/500 g
Greek yoghurt (plain, 0% fat) – Woolworths NZ$4.20/500 g, Pak'nSave NZ$3.30/500 g

sections.heading: 2. Affordable Plant‑Based Protein – Budget‑Friendly Options
sections.body: If you’re flexitarian or simply want variety, NZ supermarkets stock several plant‑based proteins that deliver 15‑20 g per serving at a low cost. These foods also bring fibre, iron and antioxidants, supporting recovery and gut health.
list: Red lentils (dry) – Woolworths NZ$3.80/kg, Pak'nSave NZ$2.90/kg
Canned chickpeas – Woolworths NZ$2.10/400 g can, Pak'nSave NZ$1.70/400 g can
Tofu (firm) – Woolworths NZ$4.20/400 g, Pak'nSave NZ$3.60/400 g
Quorn meatless pieces – Woolworths NZ$7.90/300 g, Pak'nSave NZ$6.80/300 g

cta.text: Check your eligibility for Exercise NZ’s 40‑70% gym discount – it can free up budget for quality food.

sections.heading: 3. Premium Picks – When the Extra Cost Is Worth It
sections.body: Some items carry a price premium but also offer convenience or a superior nutrient profile that can be useful for busy athletes. Use them strategically rather than as daily staples.
list: Whey protein isolate – Woolworths NZ$39.90/1 kg (≈NZ$0.40/g), Pak'nSave NZ$34.90/1 kg
